questions: If the specified column to remove is not present in the data dictionary, should the function proceed to create a heatmap with all numeric columns, or return None?
Should the heatmap include a color bar, title, axis labels, or any specific formatting (e.g., annotations, square aspect ratio)?
If after dropping the column and selecting numeric columns, only one numeric column remains, should the function return None (since correlation matrix is undefined) or produce a 1x1 heatmap?
Does 'non-numeric data is excluded from the heatmap' mean we drop entire columns with any non-numeric values, or only exclude non-numeric rows/values from each column?
Should the function close or show the matplotlib figure, or is returning the Axes object sufficient?
If the data dictionary has keys of different lengths (ragged), should the function raise an error, pad with NaN, or truncate?
Are we allowed to modify the input data dictionary, or must we work on a copy?
Should the correlation matrix use a specific method (e.g., Pearson, Spearman) or handle missing values in a particular way?
